text:
Nina: quick flag - running through onboarding flows and saw that /kb/setup/cli has a dead anchor and a missing image after the static asset rename spree. Example: https://kb.redwood.ai/setup/cli#getting-started -> 404, image /img/setup/flow.png -> 403. Repro in staging.
Carlos: thanks Nina. Which environment did you test in? staging or prod?
Nina: staging first, then spot-checked prod and saw the same 404 for that anchor. Prod image 403 might be a permissions thing.
docs-bot: nightly-link-scan: 1 dead anchor and 1 403 for /setup/cli (scan: linkscan-2026-03-22-07). Anchor: #getting-started (404). Asset: /img/setup/flow.png -> 403.
Maya: assignment: @Carlos is owner for that page; can you triage? Quick triage steps: run local linkcheck, confirm frontmatter redirects, and try replacing shortlink with canonical path.
Carlos: on it. Will run linkcheck and look at recent PRs that touched that file.
(10m) Carlos: Linkcheck shows header id changed from "Getting started" to "Getting started (CLI)" so auto-anchor changed. Looks like last PR renamed the header. Quick fix: add explicit header id to the markdown or adjust links. Also the image path in prod points to old /img/ location; new assets are under /assets/images/. Will open a micro-PR with both fixes.
Nina: customer noticed onboarding = blocked for a minute. Prefer a canary deploy and quick rollback option.
Maya: +1 to canary. Also please include a small test that verifies that the #getting-started anchor resolves (linkcheck) in CI before merge.
Carlos: Plan: 1) add explicit header id: "## Getting started {#getting-started}", 2) update image path to /assets/images/setup-flow.png, 3) add linkcheck test entry, 4) open PR and request tiny review.
(25m) Carlos: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332 - micro PR doing the header id, image path swap, and adding the anchor to the linkcheck whitelist. Tagging @Maya and @Nina for review.
Maya: quick scan LGTM. @infra-bot can you confirm the asset bucket policy for staging/prod?
infra-bot: Noted. Recent asset cleanup ran on 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Logged potential ACL tightenings for /img/* prefix. Checking runtime-assets bucket policy now.
(15m) infra-bot: Confirmed: runtime-assets bucket had a deny rule for unknown-referrers that accidentally matched the preview domain pattern. Toggled rule and ran HEAD/GET on /assets/images/setup-flow.png - GET 200 on preview and prod.
Carlos: Verified preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/setup/cli?pr=4332 anchor resolves and image loads. CI linkcheck passed.
Nina: Verified onboarding flow in staging. I'll update the Zendesk ticket (#4312) with the PR and mark ready-for-closure after prod patch.
Maya: can we add a short retro note in the docs repo about header rename risk when updating headings? Maybe a CONTRIBUTING.md tip about explicit header ids for stable anchors.
Carlos: Filed issue #1022: "Docs: prefer explicit header ids for stable anchors" and added a short blurb to CONTRIBUTING.md.
Nina: Thanks all. Closing loop. :white_check_mark: 
Carlos: small follow-up: added a one-line CI check to run linkcheck against changed files only. Might reduce noise.
Maya: Awesome. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
